'Welcome to Deforum!

The below graph provides a pluggable Deforum Animation pipeline in ComfyUI. It works frame-by-frame, so the best practice is to enable Extra options, and Auto Queue.

Deforum Parameter and Schedule nodes represent all settings available to consume after chaining up by the Deforum Iterator node, which keeps track of the current frame, generates/gets the cached latent to be denoised in the next pass. The parameters and schedule's are the same as in the auto1111 extension and in the Colab version.

Hybrid nodes are currently bypassed (purple), enabling them, and selecting a video transforms the pipeline into Deforum Hybrid. Iteration can be reset to frame 0 with the reset value being set to 1 on the iterator node. Don't forget to switch it back to 0 to use the generated image/latent."

Deforum Video Save node dumps its collected frames when the current frame's id reaches/has passed max_frames.'

summary.description: This workflow creates animated video sequences using Deforum's frame warping, noise, and conditioning blending, enhanced with IP-Adapter for image-guided generation. It outputs multiple preview images and saves the final video.
summary.title: Deforum Stable Diffusion Animation with IP-Adapter
